paradigms.question: 注释完整度是否可比？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive accession-level QC; one assembly per accession does not create replicated treatments.
paradigms.guards: BUSCO use same lineage/version/mode; complete=single+duplicated, do not stack complete twice; gene counts do not prove accuracy.

paradigms.question: 候选位点的结构与缺失证据？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive structural evidence; require independent genomic support for absence.
paradigms.guards: GFF3 1-based inclusive; BED start-1. Preserve UTR/CDS/exon differences, strand and intron compression labels.

paradigms.question: 核心、可变、特异家族各多少？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive family counts; no automatic t-test.
paradigms.guards: For fixed N: core N, specific 1, dispensable 2..N-1. Count families, not genes or transcript isoforms; exclude all-zero artifacts.

paradigms.question: 家族在多少个基因组存在？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive occupancy distribution; genomes are phylogenetically related.
paradigms.guards: Binary PAV after resolving gene ID lists; copy-number matrix must be separate. Unknown != zero; state sampling denominator.
paradigms.figure: Derived from Fig. 2a logic; not an original plotted panel

paradigms.question: 增添基因组时泛/核心家族如何变化？
paradigms.statistics: Subset combinations are not biological replicates; spread across subsets is not a population CI.
paradigms.guards: Union/intersection per subset; enumerate or declare sampling/seed. Do not infer an open pangenome from a curve without model and sampling checks.

paradigms.question: 哪些家族在谱系或材料间共享/缺失？
paradigms.statistics: Exploratory patterns; lineage-confounded enrichment needs phylogenetic/population control.
paradigms.guards: Order genomes by verified tree/metadata; presence/absence/unknown separate. Large matrix use occupancy bands; no unreported aesthetic filtering.
paradigms.figure: Derived matrix paradigm; not an original plotted panel

paradigms.question: 已有子集计数如何展示累积规律？
paradigms.statistics: Subset combinations are not biological replicates; descriptive mean and range, not biological CI.
paradigms.guards: Validate unique subset IDs and membership; core<=pan; pair same subset. Source Data enumerates all C(13,k), k=2..13.

paradigms.question: 每个基因组有哪些类型的SV？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive call counts; not independent populations.
paradigms.guards: Same reference, filter and merge definition; stacked counts do not imply unique non-overlapping events across accessions. Graph includes INS/DEL and INV<1Mb, not all SV classes.

paradigms.question: SV、基因、重复分布在哪里？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive windows; adjacent windows not independent replicates.
paradigms.guards: Shared assembly, chromosome lengths and bins; preserve per-track units. Normalized density 0..1 is not absolute event density. Missing window != zero.

paradigms.question: 倒位或共线性断点在哪里？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive alignment with orthogonal breakpoint validation.
paradigms.guards: Forward/reverse separate colors; shared lengths; one-to-many explicit; large inversion validate with Hi-C/read evidence.

paradigms.question: 组装/倒位的接触证据是否支持？
paradigms.statistics: Descriptive contact map, not proof of rearrangement alone.
paradigms.guards: Same resolution and normalization; paired maps common scale; label log1p transform. Breakpoints from independent alignment.

paradigms.question: 基因组的谱系关系是什么？
paradigms.statistics: Bootstrap support not P-value; topology not causal mechanism.
paradigms.guards: 13 tomato genomes plus potato outgroup in code; align metadata to tip IDs; branch substitutions/site vs dated Ma distinct. Paper/code settings differ, preserve both.

paradigms.question: 哪些SNP/SV与性状关联且是否校准？
paradigms.statistics: Source EMMAX kinship+PC covariates; new analysis confirm intent and population structure. Adjust across variants and traits as intended.
paradigms.guards: 0<P<=1; threshold source 7.58e-7 from 1/effective markers, not generic 0.05. QQ requires ALL tested markers, not significant hits; association is not causality.
paradigms.source_path: Genome-wide association studies/Zhu et al. 2018 GWAS/manhattan_qq.R

paradigms.question: SV受影响基因富集哪些功能？
paradigms.statistics: Source classic Fisher topGO BP nodeSize=5; recompute BH over ALL tested eligible terms before selecting display top K.
paradigms.guards: Universe must match testable annotated genes, not entire genome by habit; source adjusts only displayed top100 formatted P strings, cannot reuse as valid global FDR. Preserve source output but flag correction scope.
paradigms.source_path: Structural variation/SV merge with Alonge et al./enrichment analysis/go.R

paradigms.question: 不同等位基因材料的表型如何分布？
paradigms.statistics: Source two-sided Student t; new intent: two independent groups consider Welch, multi-factor model interactions, repeated fruit per plant use plant random effect; GWAS selection needs independent validation.
paradigms.guards: Raw independent accessions, dosage labels and unequal n; paper REF/ALT is S.galapagense orientation, not wild vs cultivated by definition. Do not reconstruct raw dots from mean SD.
